svg.title: The Big Bang and the cosmic microwave spectrum
svg.desc: (a) After the Big Bang, a hot dense early state, the universe expands and cools; galaxies form within it and recede from one another with speeds proportional to their separation. (b) The spectrum of the cosmic microwave background, intensity versus wavelength from 0.5 to 10 mm on a logarithmic scale: measured points lie exactly on the blackbody curve for T = 2.725 K, which peaks near 1 mm.
